title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: How we handle information submitted through JES Egypt Tours
intro: This policy explains how JES Egypt Tours handles personal and business contact information received through this website, including contact, booking, tailor-made and travel-trade inquiries.

sections.title: Information we receive
sections.text: We may receive your name, email address, telephone number, company details, country, travel requirements and other information you choose to include in a form or message.

sections.title: How we use the information
sections.text: We use submitted information to respond to inquiries, prepare requested proposals, coordinate confirmed travel services, maintain business records and protect the security and operation of our services.

sections.title: Service providers and travel suppliers
sections.text: When needed for a requested or confirmed service, relevant details may be shared with appropriate guides, drivers, hotels, cruise operators, transport providers or other suppliers involved in the arrangement. We may also disclose information when legally required.

sections.title: Travel-trade client information
sections.text: Client details supplied by a business partner are used for the relevant inquiry or confirmed arrangement. They are not used for unrelated direct marketing without an appropriate basis or consent.

sections.title: Retention and security
sections.text: We keep information for as long as reasonably necessary for the inquiry, booking, operational, accounting or legal purpose involved. We use reasonable administrative and technical measures to protect the information we hold.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.text: You may contact us to ask about personal information you submitted or to request a correction or deletion. A request may be subject to record-keeping, legal or operational obligations.
